elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the restart to the first answer of the new loomd.

pid.description: PID of the loomd that answers now.

previous_pid.description: PID of the loomd that was running, `null` when none was.

version.description: Version of the loomd that answers now.

was_running.description: A loomd held the lock of the loom home when the command started.

RestartVia.description: Who restarted (or started) loomd for `loom service restart`.

oneOf.description: No service: `SIGTERM` to the loomd holding the lock, then a new loomd started detached.
No service and no loomd running: a new loomd started detached.
